decision.recommendation: Reject candidate4 as the remedy for collateral losses. Drop logical-alpha optimization and rebase only RGBA4444 and direct RGBA specializations for one final original-baseline correctness/allocation/full-matrix gate.
decision.reason: Unchanged consuming controls move almost exactly with the unchanged image reference, so the focus does not establish a broad recovery. RGB555 decode improves but RGB333/RGB565 do not recover the earlier material regressions; new direct-RGBA consuming losses remain. This is scope reduction, not proof that alpha caused the collateral losses.
